Package index

Setup

Initialise (or reset) an identity graph for one or more entity types (e.g. “person”, “project”).

init_id_envs()
Initialise identity graph environments

Building the identity graph

Tag identifier columns, then add each dataset’s identifiers - and their co-occurrences - to the graph.

mark_id()
Mark identity columns for entity resolution
add_to_identity_graph()
Add a marked dataset to its identity graph(s)

Resolving identities

Collapse the graph’s connected components into master identities, and retrieve the resulting table.

generate_master_identity_table()
Collapse an identity graph into a master identity table
get_master_table()
Retrieve a previously generated master identity table

Using resolved identities

Attach a resolved master ID to any marked dataset, or restrict a new dataset to identities already known to the graph.

join_master_ids()
Attach resolved master IDs onto a dataset
filter_by_existing_identities()
Restrict a dataset to rows matching an existing identity graph
